name: Cardenal Herrera CEU
description: CEU Cardenal Herrera University is a private university belonging to the Group CEU University (CEU Universities), the first private educational group in Spain by number of students and the second for quality of their studies (Ranking The Higher Education - 2020). Its official studies are accredited and recognized in the European Education Area Higher. It has Faculties of Medicine, Law and Economics, Communication, Humanities and Gastronomy among others, adding more than 100 Bachelor's degrees, more than 15 programs of Official master's degree and an important joint doctoral school with the other Universities CEU, the CEINDO school. The University stands out for being the benchmark in the application of CEU values: Quality training, continuous support of students in teaching, orientation career and international dimension, which is manifested in the high number of international students in their classrooms.
